about: The pipelex-sdk command's contract: each case is a command line, the files and stdin it finds, the answers the API gives, and what the command must print and exit with.
Both SDKs run every case through their own command and their real client, serving the recorded answers through an HTTP mock. js/docs/cli.md, 'The case table', describes every field.
The source is js/tests/fixtures/cli-cases.json. Its copy, python/tests/fixtures/cli-cases.json, is written by `make shared-files` at the repository root, and is never edited.

files.text:
#!/bin/sh
# receipt-review: runs github.com/acme/methods/receipt-review@v1.0.0 on the Pipelex API.
# Written by {{WRITER}} {{SDK_VERSION}}. Needs {{NEEDS}}, and PIPELEX_API_KEY in the environment.
# Usage: ./receipt-review --inputs inputs.json, or ./receipt-review --inputs-template to see what to fill in.
exec {{RUNNER}} run --method 'github.com/acme/methods/receipt-review@v1.0.0' --pipe 'receipts.review_receipt' "$@"
